name: Conservative offline interface compatibility verification
summary: Native configured verifiers and bound HTTP coordinators or delegated agents record pinned interface compatibility attestations from locally configured Git object sources. Bounded JSON Schema2020-12 and OpenAPI3.1 JSON subset proofs use request and response variance; unsupported or unproved input remains unknown. Contributor reports are untrusted and cannot clear trusted breaking evidence. Current issuer, delegation, independent-party policy, source configuration and exact record pins determine trusted evidence; both HTTP cached replay paths recheck current authority. Per-interface API flags expose derived compatibility; no automatic lifecycle change. Host interface-verify and interface-report use native actors.
